name: midnight-docs-drift
description: Detect and repair drifted midnightntwrk/midnight-docs pages. Scans active org repos (incl. LFDT-Minokawa/compact), maps docs pages to the repos they document, flags pages older than their sources, then extracts, classifies, severity-ranks, verifies, and fixes stale claims through the interactive /update-drifted-docs command — reusing the midnight-fact-check and midnight-verify plugins.
